conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Richard from Amazon Account Security. I'm calling regarding an urgent matter with your Amazon account that needs your attention.
Uh, hi, yes. What's going on? I'm a little busy but I can talk.

I completely understand, and I'll keep this brief. We detected a hold on your Amazon account due to an unusual login attempt from a new device. For your protection, some funds and purchases are currently frozen.
Frozen? I didn't notice anything. Is this about my last order? I really need it soon.

I know how important timely deliveries are, and I want to ensure your account is fully restored. We'll just need to verify your identity and some recent activity. Can you confirm the name and billing address listed on your Amazon account?
Sure, it's Emily Chan, 425 Maple Avenue, Cedarwood.
Thank you, Emily. That matches our records. Now, to proceed, may I have the last four digits of the card you most recently used on your account?
It should be 3251, I think. Is that enough?

Perfect, that helps. For the security process, Amazon requests a quick payment verification. This is a standard protocol and ensures no unauthorized activity occurs. Have you ever used Zelle, Cash App, or any cryptocurrency wallets for payments before?
I've used Zelle once or twice, but not crypto. Why do I need that for Amazon?

Great question, this is a one-time verification that confirms your ownership of the account. It's a secure process, and the verification amount is fully refunded once complete. Are you able to access your Zelle account now?
Uh, maybe. I have to check. Is this like a test payment?
Exactly, it's simply to verify you control both the Amazon and linked payment accounts. No funds are permanently removed; it's a standard security check.
Okay, if it's necessary, I guess I can do that. How much do I need to send?
The system requests a $900 verification transfer. I'll provide you with our secure Amazon verification Zelle details. Once complete, your account will be unlocked and the funds returned.
$900? That's a lot. Are you sure this is Amazon policy?

I absolutely understand your concern, Emily. Rest assured, this is a temporary hold. As soon as our system registers the payment, it will be credited back. You'll also receive a confirmation email from Amazon. Let's take it one step at a time.
Alright, if this is the only way. Where do I send it?
Thank you for your cooperation. Please open your Zelle app and enter the following recipient email: amazonverifications@consultmail.com. Enter $900 as the amount.
Okay, I'm typing that in now. Should I put anything in the memo?
Yes, in the memo field, please write 'Amazon Security ID 2107'. This helps us track your verification instantly.
Done. It's asking me to confirm, so I should go ahead?
Yes, please confirm the transfer. Once it's processed, let me know so I can update your verification status in our system.
Alright, I just sent it. Can you check if it went through?
Thank you, Emily. I'll check the system now. While I do, could you confirm the phone number linked to your Amazon account? This further secures your profile.
It's 917-555-8912. Is that all you need?

That's perfect. Your cooperation is greatly appreciated. The payment is being processed, this usually takes a few minutes. If you receive any confirmation texts or emails from Zelle or Amazon, please let me know right away.
Okay, I'll keep an eye out. I have to finish something for my dad, but I'll watch my phone.
Of course, take your time. I'll stay on the line for support. Your security is our top priority.
